description: Debrief's Claude Code hooks. Each runs the debrief command on PATH; without it, session start says how to install it and the others do nothing.

hooks.command: command -v debrief >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"◪ debrief · not running: the debrief command is not on PATH (npm install -g debrief-cli)"}'; exit 0; }; exec debrief hook session-start --host claude-code
command -v debrief >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec debrief hook subagent-start --host claude-code
command -v debrief >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec debrief hook user-prompt-submit --host claude-code
command -v debrief >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec debrief hook pre-tool-use --host claude-code
command -v debrief >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec debrief hook stop --host claude-code
